automationNotes: Doc: App Switcher → **Personalize** → project → **Events** → row **Actions** ⋮ → **Edit** → **Edit Event** modal (**Key**, **Description**) → **Save**. Row match: **`PERSONALIZE_EDIT_EVENT_ROW_CONTAINS`** (default **`AUTO_EVENT`** — matches `create-event` keys). Flow updates **Description** only so **Save** enables reliably (key edits can fail validation / duplicate checks). Handlers: **`rules/core/actionRules.ts`** (`openRowActionMenu` / **`resolvePersonalizeAttributesEditLi`**), **`event-form-submit`**, modal title **`cs-modal-title-edit-event`**. See doc warning on changing keys used in A/B tests.
